Whitelisted trading address settable only by owner.
Public mapping of token balances; mutated with unchecked arithmetic.

Maximum sale amount set by init.
Maximum number of sales per address set by init.
Total token supply set in the constructor.
Public payable transfer that delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender,...).
Internal view gate that whitelists owner/UNI/trade addresses and calls condition.
Public payable transfer that mutates allowances and balances with raw arithmetic.
Public payable approval that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view enforcing sale limits before allowing a transfer.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to attacker-supplied code.
Owner-only setter for sale limits and sale count.

Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress state variable.
Internal pure helper deriving a Uniswap pair address via keccak256.
Constructor setting name, symbol, supply, owner and initial balances/allowances.

Raw addition/subtraction/multiplication on balances, allowances and totals without SafeMath.

edges.reason: delegate requires msg.sender == owner before performing arbitrary code execution.
init requires msg.sender == owner to modify sale limits.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner to move balances.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner to set the whitelist address.
constructor assigns owner from msg.sender granting all privileges.
transferFrom checks allowance[_from][msg.sender] before spending on behalf of another account.
delegate() forwards control to the arbitrary low-level delegatecall.
Attacker-controlled address parameter a is the delegatecall target.
Attacker-controlled calldata parameter b is passed to the delegatecall.
transferFrom mutates allowance and balanceOf with unchecked subtraction and addition.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from].
balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] updated without SafeMath overflow checks.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] decremented with raw arithmetic.
transfer forwards execution to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transfer recipient _to is forwarded to transferFrom.
transfer amount _value is forwarded into unchecked transferFrom arithmetic.
ensure calls condition when the sender is not whitelisted.
ensure reads canSale whitelist to bypass condition checks.
ensure compares _from against tradeAddress.
ensure compares _from/_to against owner.
condition reads _saleNum to limit the number of sales.
condition reads _minSale lower bound.
condition reads _maxSale upper bound.
init writes _minSale from the token parameter.
init writes _maxSale from the maxToken parameter.
init writes _saleNum from the saleNum parameter.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length and mutates balances without SafeMath.
batchSend subtracts and adds to balanceOf with raw arithmetic.
setTradeAddress writes the state variable tradeAddress.
constructor assigns msg.sender to owner.
constructor grants unlimited allowance to the hardcoded router address.
constructor multiplies _supply by 10**decimals without overflow checking.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
transfer binds its recipient parameter.
transferFrom uses the _value parameter directly in unchecked arithmetic.
batchSend length of _tos multiplies into the unchecked total.
batchSend _value feeds unchecked multiplication and balance additions.
setTradeAddress writes its addr parameter into tradeAddress.
ensure compares _from against the computed Uniswap pair address _UNI.
batchSend local total is derived from unchecked multiplication.
batchSend loop index drives the per-recipient transfer loop.
pairFor is called transitively from ensure via the pair derivation.

normalization_plan.reason: Recipient parameter exists only to be forwarded from transfer into transferFrom.
Amount parameter exists only to be forwarded from transfer into transferFrom.
Source parameter is used solely by the whitelist gate in ensure.
Destination parameter is used solely by the whitelist gate in ensure.
Amount parameter is used solely for the condition check in ensure.
Source parameter is consumed by the balance and allowance logic of transferFrom.
Destination parameter is consumed by the balance update of transferFrom.
Amount parameter feeds the unchecked arithmetic of transferFrom.
Spender parameter is only used to index the allowance mapping in approve.
Value parameter is only written into the allowance mapping in approve.
Source parameter is only used to read _onSaleNum in condition.
Value parameter is only compared against min and max sale bounds in condition.
Target address parameter is the direct input to the delegatecall operation.
Calldata parameter is the direct payload of the delegatecall operation.
Sale count parameter is only assigned to the _saleNum state variable.
Token parameter is only used to derive _minSale.
Max token parameter is only used to derive _maxSale.
Recipient array parameter drives the batchSend loop and total computation.
Value parameter drives the unchecked total and per-recipient balance updates.
Address parameter is only written into the tradeAddress state variable.
Local pair address is computed and compared only inside ensure.
Local total is derived from unchecked multiplication inside batchSend.
Loop index exists only to iterate the batchSend transfer loop.
